audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track starts with the clear, low-frequency sound of a cardboard box being opened. The man emits an enthusiastic 'Wow' with high vocal arousal and positive valence. No background music is present yet, emphasizing the physical action of unboxing. (2) Upbeat, major-key electronic background music fades in at approximately 124 BPM. The man speaks rapidly in a high-pitched, excited tone about receiving a gift from Porter. His speech is clear and authoritative yet very friendly. (3) Continuous sounds of paper rustling and plastic crinkling overlap with the man's narrative. He maintains a high speech rate while describing his long-term usage of the brand. A young girl's soft laughter is heard as background chatter. (4) A distinctive 'ding' sound effect occurs as the man displays a card. His voice remains energetic but lowers slightly in pitch as he reads the card content. The BGM remains steady with a moderate percussive beat. (5) Bubbling and cartoonish sound effects are used to punctuate humorous moments. The sound of collective laughter from the man and girl fills the mid-range frequencies. The man's tone becomes more playful and comedic. (6) The video ends with a high-intensity vocal delivery from the man, declaring himself a '帅哥' (handsome guy). The BGM continues until a sharp hard cut at the very end. The overall audio mix is bright and dynamic.
